scenario: AITA for getting mad at my bf for always walking in front of me? | Everytime my boyfriend and I are walking somewhere, he tends to walk much faster than me. I’m actually a pretty fast walker myself when alone, but when going out with him, either I’m in heels half the time so it’s harder to walk super fast, or even in flats, sometimes I just want to walk alongside him and hold hands and have a conversation. AITA and he really can’t help it?
